description: Validation test suite for Tailwind CSS technology skill rules (TW01-TW08)

testCases.description: Verify detection of dynamic class name interpolation breaking Tailwind scanner discovery

findings.message: String interpolation constructs partial utility class names, preventing static Tailwind source discovery.

expected.notes: Dynamic utility string construction causes missing styles in production builds.
Static class map provides complete utility strings detectable by Tailwind source scanner.

testCases.description: Verify detection of unvarianted conflicting utility classes combined without tailwind-merge

findings.message: Conflicting base utilities combined without tailwind-merge, causing non-deterministic CSS precedence overrides.

expected.notes: Combining p-2 and p-4 without twMerge causes non-deterministic specificity behavior.
tailwind-merge correctly resolves utility class conflicts.
